label: def:electron-shell-braid-capacity
title: Electron shell as braid bonding capacity
html:
Definition. Electron shell as braid bonding capacity

Definition. In the atomic braid \mathcal{A}(Z, N), each of the Z electrons is a trefoil T_{2,3} = \sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0 in H_3(q) Hopf-linked to the nuclear core. A bonding site is a position in the atomic braid available to an electron. The shell capacity is the number of bonding sites at each shell level, determined by the electron arrangement that minimises \Phi_1.

An atom with Z electrons fills shells in order of increasing \Phi_1 contribution.
